title: Un budget qui résiste aux raccourcis
summary: A household compares two ways to reduce monthly costs and asks whether the apparent saving shifts costs elsewhere.

sentences.fr: Dans un exemple de budget fictif, la famille de Leïla a comparé deux options de transport pour les déplacements du mois.
sentences.en: In a fictional budget example, Leïla's family compared two transport options for the month's trips.

sentences.fr: Un abonnement coûtait quatre-vingt-dix dollars; les billets achetés séparément auraient coûté environ cent douze dollars.
sentences.en: A pass cost ninety dollars; tickets bought separately would have cost about one hundred twelve dollars.

sentences.fr: À première vue, l'abonnement semblait donc permettre une économie de vingt-deux dollars.
sentences.en: At first glance, the pass therefore appeared to save twenty-two dollars.

sentences.fr: Toutefois, le calcul ne comprenait pas deux déplacements exceptionnels que la famille aurait dû faire en voiture.
sentences.en: However, the calculation did not include two unusual trips the family would have had to make by car.

sentences.fr: Leïla a ajouté le coût estimé de ces trajets et a vérifié si l'abonnement couvrait les zones nécessaires.
sentences.en: Leïla added the estimated cost of those trips and checked whether the pass covered the required zones.

sentences.fr: L'écart devenait plus petit, mais l'abonnement restait intéressant pour les semaines où toute la famille utilisait le transport collectif.
sentences.en: The difference became smaller, but the pass remained useful for weeks when the whole family used public transit.

sentences.fr: Ils ont choisi de revoir leurs dépenses après un mois plutôt que de traiter l'estimation initiale comme une économie certaine.
sentences.en: They chose to review their expenses after one month rather than treat the initial estimate as a guaranteed saving.
sentences.note: A saving estimate depends on what is included; check extra costs and usage conditions before treating a headline difference as real savings.

quiz.prompt: What was the apparent difference between the pass and separate tickets?
quiz.explain: The text compares $90 with about $112, a difference of $22.

quiz.prompt: What had the first calculation left out?
options: The number of days in a month
Two unusual trips the family might need to make by car
The price of each separate ticket
quiz.explain: The fourth sentence names the trips missing from the calculation.

quiz.prompt: What did the family decide to do?
options: Assume the first estimate was guaranteed
Review actual expenses after a month
quiz.explain: The final sentence describes a review after one month.
